outputs.explanation: Panel shows super-resolution microscopy reconstructions (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) for CtpG-mEos; it is not a plot displaying an average value, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel shows the same type of super-resolution microscopy reconstructions as (A) but for PacL2-mEos; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Scatter/dot plot of number of clusters per cell for PacL2 vs CtpG, showing mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray data points per cell, as stated in the caption.
Scatter/dot plot of cluster sizes, with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cluster, as stated in the caption.
Scatter/dot plot of the percentage of molecules in clusters per cell, with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots per cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel shows representative super-resolution localizations and trajectory overlays (microscopy-derived visualizations), not a plot of averaged summary statistics.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (a frequency distribution, not a mean/average summary) and bottom is a line plot showing many individual molecule trajectories (MSD curves); both plot types are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points, as histograms and line plots already convey the underlying individual data/distribution.
Panel shows trajectory maps, a kymograph, and example individual trajectories, i.e., raw/individual microscopy-derived data rather than a plot of averaged values, so the check does not apply.
